briefdescription.para: Phase-3 multi-tier cache manager for graph traversal results.

detaileddescription.para:
Provides:
themis::graph::GraphMultiTierCache – Hot/Warm/Cold three-tier cache
themis::graph::GraphTraversalResultCache – Typed cache for BFS/DFS results

Design goals:
Cache hit ratio ≥ 85% on repeated traversal workloads.
LRU eviction within each tier.
Automatic promotion (Cold → Warm → Hot) on repeated access.
Thread-safe for concurrent readers/writers.
